official_name: Goldberg's (1999) Preliminary IPIP Scales Measuring Constructs Similar to the NEO-PI-R Facet Scales — 30 facets x 10 items

field_completeness.text_en: complete (300/300, verbatim from the official scoring key page)
field_completeness.text_zh: NOT AVAILABLE (no official Chinese version for this 300-item set)
field_completeness.facet: complete (30 facets, verbatim headers with printed alphas)
field_completeness.keying: complete (+ keyed / – keyed, verbatim). NOTE: the +/− split is NOT 5/5 for every facet — see facet_keying_balance below.

notes: item_no is sequential in the official page order (1-300): N1..N6, E1..E6, O1..O6, A1..A6, C1..C6, 10 items each.
This 300-item set is the parent pool for the short forms: all 60 items of the IPIP-NEO-60 appear verbatim here (see README cross-check).
Domain-level counts printed on the companion comparison page (newNEO_FacetsTable.htm): each domain has 60 items (30+ / 30- for N, 36+/24- for E, 28+/32- for O, etc.) = 300 total.

items.text_zh: 担心会发生最糟糕的情况

items.text_en: Get caught up in my problems.
items.text_zh: 会深陷自己的问题之中

items.text_en: Am not easily bothered by things.
Am relaxed most of the time.
Am not easily disturbed by events.
Don't worry about things that have already happened.
items.text_zh: 不为已经发生的事担忧

items.text_en: Am often in a bad mood.
Am often down in the dumps.
Have a low opinion of myself.
Feel that my life lacks direction.
items.text_zh: 觉得自己的生活没有方向

items.text_en: Am afraid that I will do the wrong thing.
Find it difficult to approach others.
items.text_zh: 感觉自己很难接近别人

items.text_en: Am afraid to draw attention to myself.

items.text_zh: 只有和朋友在一起的时候我才会感到自在
在陌生情境里也很自在

items.text_en: Am not bothered by difficult social situations.
items.text_zh: 不会被复杂的社交情境所困扰

items.text_en: Am able to stand up for myself.
Don't know why I do some of the things I do.
items.text_zh: 不知道自己为什么会做某些事

items.text_en: Am able to control my cravings.
Never spend more than I can afford.
items.text_zh: 从不花超过自己能力的钱
感到被各种事情压得喘不过气来

items.text_en: Feel that I'm unable to deal with things.
items.text_zh: 感觉自己处理事情力不从心

items.text_en: Am calm even in tense situations.
items.text_zh: 即使在紧张局面下也很镇定
很快就能和别人热络起来
和其他人待在一起时，我觉得很自在

items.text_en: Am hard to get to know.

items.text_zh: 和别人在一起时常感到不自在

items.text_en: Am not really interested in others.
items.text_zh: 对别人并不真的感兴趣

items.text_en: Talk to a lot of different people at parties.
items.text_zh: 在聚会上，我会和很多不同的人交谈

items.text_en: Enjoy being part of a group.
Involve others in what I am doing.
items.text_zh: 会拉别人一起参与我的事

items.text_en: Can talk others into doing things.
Wait for others to lead the way.
Don't like to draw attention to myself.
items.text_zh: 不喜欢成为别人注意的焦点

items.text_en: Do a lot in my spare time.
items.text_zh: 我的闲暇时间非常充实

items.text_en: Can manage many things at the same time.
Let things proceed at their own pace.
items.text_zh: 让事情按自己的步调走

items.text_en: Enjoy being part of a loud crowd.
Am willing to try anything once.
Would never go hang gliding or bungee jumping.
items.text_zh: 绝不会去玩滑翔或蹦极
我的快乐会感染周围的人

items.text_en: Look at the bright side of life.
Like to get lost in thought.
Do not have a good imagination.
Believe in the importance of art.
See beauty in things that others might not notice.
items.text_zh: 我能发现别人看不到的美

items.text_en: Do not enjoy going to art museums.
Do not enjoy watching dance performances.

items.text_zh: 能强烈感受到自己的情绪
对理想与信念充满热情

items.text_en: Enjoy examining myself and my life.
items.text_zh: 喜欢审视自己和自己的生活

items.text_en: Am not easily affected by my emotions.

items.text_zh: 很少察觉到自己的情绪反应

items.text_en: Experience very few emotional highs and lows.
items.text_zh: 很少经历情绪的大起大落

items.text_en: Don't understand people who get emotional.
items.text_zh: 不理解那些情绪化的人
相比墨守成规，我更喜欢有变化。

items.text_en: Prefer to stick with things that I know.
items.text_zh: 我更喜欢做自己熟悉的事情

items.text_en: Don't like the idea of change.

items.text_zh: 喜欢阅读有挑战性的材料

items.text_en: Can handle a lot of information.
Am not interested in abstract ideas.

items.text_zh: 会避免参与关于哲学的讨论
理解抽象概念对我来说有些困难

items.text_en: Am not interested in theoretical discussions.
items.text_zh: 对理论性的讨论不感兴趣
回避有难度的阅读内容

items.text_en: Tend to vote for liberal political candidates.
items.text_zh: 倾向于投票给自由派候选人

items.text_en: Believe that there is no absolute right and wrong.
items.text_zh: 相信没有绝对的对与错

items.text_en: Believe that criminals should receive help rather than punishment.
items.text_zh: 认为罪犯应该得到帮助而非惩罚
相信存在唯一真正的宗教

items.text_en: Tend to vote for conservative political candidates.
items.text_zh: 倾向于投票给保守派候选人

items.text_en: Believe that too much tax money goes to support artists.
items.text_zh: 认为太多税款被用来资助艺术家

items.text_en: Believe laws should be strictly enforced.
items.text_zh: 认为法律应当被严格执行

items.text_en: Believe that we coddle criminals too much.
items.text_zh: 认为我们对罪犯太过宽容

items.text_en: Believe that we should be tough on crime.
items.text_zh: 认为我们应该严惩犯罪

items.text_en: Like to stand during the national anthem.
Believe that others have good intentions.
items.text_zh: 相信他人的出发点是好的

items.text_en: Believe that people are basically moral.
items.text_zh: 相信人本质上是善良守德的

items.text_en: Think that all will be well.
Believe that people are essentially evil.
items.text_zh: 认为人本质上是邪恶的

items.text_en: Would never cheat on my taxes.
Use others for my own ends.
items.text_zh: 会利用他人来达成自己的目的

items.text_en: Know how to get around the rules.
items.text_zh: 知道怎么钻规则的空子
为了领先别人，我会采用作弊的方式

items.text_en: Pretend to be concerned for others.
Have a good word for everyone.
Am indifferent to the feelings of others.
items.text_zh: 对他人的感受漠不关心

items.text_en: Dislike being the center of attention.
items.text_zh: 不喜欢成为关注的焦点

items.text_en: Believe that I am better than others.
Have a high opinion of myself.
Know the answers to many questions.
Make myself the center of attention.
items.text_zh: 让自己成为关注的焦点

items.text_en: Feel sympathy for those who are worse off than myself.
items.text_zh: 我同情那些处境不如自己的人
会替别人的不幸感到难过

items.text_en: Am not interested in other people's problems.
items.text_zh: 对别人遇到的麻烦事不感兴趣

items.text_en: Believe in an eye for an eye.
Try not to think about the needy.
items.text_zh: 我尽量不去想那些需要帮助的人

items.text_en: Believe people should fend for themselves.
items.text_zh: 认为人就该自己顾自己
在自己所从事的领域出类拔萃
对自己的立场很有把握

items.text_en: Know how to get things done.
Don't see the consequences of things.
Do things according to a plan.
Often forget to put things back in their proper place.
items.text_zh: 经常忘记把东西放回原处

items.text_en: Leave a mess in my room.

items.text_zh: 我的东西放得到处都是

items.text_en: Am not bothered by messy people.

items.text_zh: 不会因杂乱无章而困扰

items.text_en: Get others to do my duties.
Do the opposite of what is asked.
items.text_zh: 故意做和要求相反的事

items.text_en: Plunge into tasks with all my heart.
Do more than what's expected of me.
items.text_zh: 我会超出预期地完成任务或工作

items.text_en: Set high standards for myself and others.
items.text_zh: 对自己和他人都高标准要求

items.text_en: Am not highly motivated to succeed.
Do just enough work to get by.
items.text_zh: 在工作或学习上，我不会多做，过得去就行

items.text_en: Put little time and effort into my work.
items.text_zh: 对工作或学业不怎么投入时间和精力
能执行自己制定的计划

items.text_en: Find it difficult to get down to work.
Need a push to get started.
items.text_zh: 需要被人推一把才开始
拖很久才开始做一件事
会不经过思考就开始行动

items.text_en: Like to act on a whim.
